name: Kohinata Hanako
source:
A full-time housewife in her late thirties. She is calm, very kind, and receptive. She is the type of woman who likes to make men feel good about themselves and see their faces when they are happy. She has a pure and innocent heart that knows no doubts.

She grew up in an ordinary family where her parents loved her very much. She attended a public school all her life, and after graduating from a junior college, she got a job at a department store.

She married a man she met in a college club and retired on her own. She has never known any other man except her husband. Her husband has been impotent for many years and she is frustrated.

translation:
三十多岁的全职主妇。她沉着、温柔又善于接受，是那种喜欢让男人找回自信、欣赏男人幸福表情的女性。她拥有纯洁天真的心，从不怀疑别人。

她在父母深爱的普通家庭中长大，一直就读公立学校，毕业于短期大学后，在百货商店工作。

她与大学社团里认识的男人结婚，并主动辞职。除了丈夫，她从未认识过其他男人。丈夫多年来阳痿，她对此十分郁闷。
